desc_zh: 用学术邮箱、做非商业科研或教学，可申请 Research Plan：每月 50 额度、15 名成员、20 个项目、增强增强，以及 RF-DETR 研究许可（非商业）。申请时，该工作区里的数据会公开到 Roboflow Universe，不要放不能公开的数据。已在付费或试用付费套餐的人看不到申请按钮，要先取消试用。课堂需求可另找官方说明是师生项目。这是审核额度，不是无上限算力。
desc_en: If you're using an academic email address for non-commercial research or educational purposes, you can apply for the Research Plan: 50 quota per month, 15 members, 20 projects, enhanced features, and an RF-DETR research license (non-commercial). When you apply, the data in this workspace will be made public on Roboflow Universe, so do not include any data that cannot be shared publicly. Users already on a paid plan or a paid trial will not see the application button; you must first cancel your trial. For classroom needs, you can contact official support separately and specify that it is a teacher-student project. This is a reviewed quota, not unlimited computing power.
claim_zh:
1. 用学术邮箱登录一个工作区。不要把不能公开的数据放进去。
2. 打开设置里的 Plan & Billing，拉到「Using Roboflow for research or education?」，点 Request Access。看不到按钮就先取消付费试用，再点击本页的「前往官网领取」看说明。
3. 选科研计划并确认升级。课堂定制需求按页面说明联系官方，并写明师生项目。
claim_en:
1. Log in to a workspace using an academic email address. Do not include any data that cannot be shared publicly.
2. Open Plan & Billing in the settings, scroll down to "Using Roboflow for research or education?", and click Request Access. If you don't see the button, first cancel your paid trial, then click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page to view the instructions.
3. Select the research plan and confirm the upgrade. For customized classroom needs, contact official support as described on the page and specify that it is a teacher-student project.

name_zh: WorkBuddy 教育公益版 教师每月 2000 积分
name_en: WorkBuddy Education Public Welfare Edition: 2000 Points per Month for Teachers
desc_zh: 腾讯 SSV 数字教育实验室和 WorkBuddy 团队面向全国在职教师的 AI 教学助理，不限地区和学段。审核通过后每人每月 2000 积分，每月 1 日自动补满，文章写明可连续领取 12 个月；账号本身长期有效。积分用完后仍可使用免费模型。2026 年 10 月至 12 月为试点期，2000 积分所有模型通用；试点期结束后，混元 4 单独 1600 积分，其他模型 400 积分，混元 3 暂时不限量。这套积分和个人版不互通，数据也不会自动同步。
desc_en: The Tencent SSV Digital Education Lab and the WorkBuddy team are offering an AI teaching assistant to all working teachers across China, regardless of region or educational level. After approval, each teacher will receive 2000 points per month, automatically replenished on the 1st of each month. The article states that this benefit can be claimed continuously for 12 months, and the account itself remains valid long-term. Free models can still be used after the points are exhausted. The pilot period runs from October to December 2026, during which all models will be accessible with the 2000 points. After the pilot period, Hunyuan 4 will require 1600 points separately, while other models will cost 400 points. Hunyuan 3 will temporarily have no usage limit. This point system is not interchangeable with the personal edition, and data will not be automatically synchronized.
claim_zh:
1. 在职老师打开公告，点「阅读原文」填写申领表：doc.weixin.qq.com/forms/AJEAIQdfAAoAXcAJQZtABoCNHisaiAXTf。也可以在「腾讯SSV」公众号菜单选择「一起SSV」-「WB教育公益版」。
2. 填写教师身份信息。审核通过后 3 个工作日内开通。登录必须使用报名时登记的手机号，一个手机号对应一个教育公益版账号。
3. 电脑端打开 WorkBuddy 5.8 及以上版本，用手机号验证码登录，在账号列表中选择「教育公益版」。已经装过的升级即可；有区域培训通知时，按通知里的链接下载。
4. 小程序登录时选择「企业版」，再输入登记的手机号。如果当前登的是个人版，先退出再按这个方式登录。
5. 学校要批量开通，填写批量收集表后发到项目群，或发到 p_guibzhang@tencent.com。生成内容先人工核对再用于课堂。
claim_en:
1. Working teachers should open the announcement and click "Read Original" to fill out the application form: doc.weixin.qq.com/forms/AJEAIQdfAAoAXcAJQZtABoCNHisaiAXTf. Alternatively, select "Together SSV" > "WB Education Public Welfare Edition" from the menu of the official "Tencent SSV" WeChat account.
2. Fill in your teacher identification information. The account will be activated within 3 business days after approval. You must use the mobile number registered during sign-up to log in; each mobile number corresponds to one Education Public Welfare Edition account.
3. Open WorkBuddy version 5.8 or higher on your computer, log in with the verification code for your mobile number, and select "Education Public Welfare Edition" from the account list. If already installed, simply upgrade. When a regional training notice is issued, download the app via the link provided in the notice.
4. When logging in via the mini-program, select "Enterprise Edition" and then enter your registered mobile number. If you are currently logged into the personal edition, log out first and then follow this procedure to log in.
5. For schools wishing to activate accounts in bulk, fill out the bulk collection form and send it to the project group or to p_guibzhang@tencent.com. Content generated by the tool should be manually reviewed before use in the classroom.

desc_zh: 符合条件的学生可以免费使用 Gemini 的学生方案 12 个月。名额、国家和地区经常变，以学生页能不能验证为准，不是所有学校邮箱都能过。
desc_en: Eligible students can use Gemini's student plan for free for 12 months. Availability, quotas, and eligible countries/regions change frequently. Approval depends on whether you can complete verification on the student page; not all school email addresses will work.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用页面要求的 Google 账号登录。
2. 完成学生验证。通过后看账户里的 12 个月到期日，到期前取消才会避免续费。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page and sign in with the Google account required by the page.
2. Complete student verification. Once approved, check the 12-month expiration date in your account. Cancel before the expiration date to avoid automatic renewal.

desc_zh: OpenAI 面向美国持牌临床医生提供专属医疗工作区，通过身份验证后可访问专为临床工作流程设计的安全 ChatGPT 环境。
desc_en: OpenAI offers a secure ChatGPT medical workspace built for clinical workflows. US licensed clinicians can verify their credentials to gain access.
claim_zh:
1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」
2. 登录或注册 ChatGPT 账号
3. 按照页面指引完成美国临床医生身份验证
4. 验证成功后即可访问专为临床工作流程打造的安全 ChatGPT 医疗工作区

注意：仅限美国持牌临床医生申请。
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page
2. Log in or sign up for a ChatGPT account
3. Follow the page instructions to complete U.S. clinician identity verification
4. Once verification succeeds, you can access the secure ChatGPT medical workspace built for clinical workflows

Note: Only U.S. licensed clinicians can apply.

desc_zh: NoteGPT 用来总结 YouTube 等视频。学生可以免费使用一个月，之后是否收费以定价页为准。
desc_en: NoteGPT is used to summarize videos from YouTube and other platforms. Students can use it for free for one month. Whether it will be paid afterward is subject to the pricing page.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，注册并找到学生或教育方案。
2. 完成验证后看账户里的到期日。一个月结束前如果不再使用，记得取消。
claim_en:
1. Click 「Go to Official Website to Claim」 on this page, register, and find the student or education plan.
2. After completing verification, check the expiration date in your account. If you no longer plan to use it before the month ends, remember to cancel.

name_zh: 豆包开学季：免费领 3 个月专业版
name_en: Doubao Back-to-School: 3 Months Pro Free for Students
desc_zh: 字节跳动豆包面向在校大学生推出 2026 开学季福利：完成学生认证可免费领取 3 个月专业版订阅，另享 2.5 倍免费额度，专业版标准套餐学生价 38 元/月（原价 68 元）。
desc_en: ByteDance Doubao's 2026 back-to-school offer: verified college students get 3 months of Pro free, 2.5× free quota, and Pro Standard at ¥38/mo (was ¥68).
claim_zh:
1. 更新并打开豆包电脑版（活动主要在 PC 端参与，每账号限领一次）。
2. 进入「设置 → 豆包专业版订阅」，点击右上角「学生权益」；或在工作任务模式发送「我要领取学生优惠」。
3. 按提示绑定抖音账号，用学生证或学信网在线验证报告完成学生身份认证。
4. 认证通过后领取 3 个月专业版订阅；同时可享 2.5 倍免费额度，以及专业版标准套餐学生价 38 元/月。
5. 侧边栏「技能 · 连接器 · 工作伙伴」→「开学季」专区可体验新生报到、课程学习、汇报 PPT、秋招求职等学生技能。

注意：开学季期间有效，具体以官方页面为准。
claim_en:
1. Update and open Doubao Desktop (the activity is mainly on PC; each account can claim once).
2. Go to "Settings → Doubao Pro Subscription" and click "Student Benefits" in the upper right; or send "I want to claim the student discount" in Work Task mode.
3. Follow the prompts to link your Douyin account, and complete student identity verification with your student ID or CHSI online verification report.
4. After verification is approved, claim the 3-month Pro subscription; you can also get 2.5x free quota and the standard Pro plan student price of 38 CNY/month.
5. In the sidebar "Skills · Connectors · Work Partners" → "Back-to-School Season" section, you can try student skills such as freshman registration, course learning, presentation PPT, and fall recruitment job hunting.

Note: Valid during the back-to-school season; subject to the official page.

desc_zh: 用学校邮箱登录后，Scira Pro 结账价为 $9/月；普通邮箱为 $15/月。邮箱域名匹配即可，不需要优惠码。
desc_en: Sign in with a school email and Scira Pro is $9 a month at checkout, versus $15 otherwise. The discount applies when the verified email matches an allowed domain. No coupon code.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 用学校邮箱注册或登录。
3. 结账页会显示 $9/月的 Pro 价。域名不在允许列表时仍是 $15/月。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. Sign up or sign in with a school email.
3. The checkout page will show the $9/month Pro price. If the domain is not on the allowed list, it is still $15/month.

desc_zh: Genymotion Desktop 是 Android 模拟器。教育版每年 $49，按每名学生、每台电脑计，学生、教师和学校都能申请，要学生证或教师证等有效证明。功能和独立开发者年付 $239.99 那档一样，含全部 Pro 组件。免费个人版功能更少，没有最新 Android。云端 SaaS 不走这个教育价。
desc_en: Genymotion Desktop is an Android emulator. The Education Edition costs $49 per year, per student and per computer. Students, teachers, and schools can apply, requiring valid proof such as a student ID or teacher ID. Its features are the same as the $239.99 annual plan for independent developers, including all Pro components. The free personal edition has fewer features and does not include the latest Android versions. The cloud-based SaaS version does not offer this educational pricing.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，在 Desktop 价格里选 Educational 申请。
2. 提交学生证或教师证等在读、任教证明，等审核。
3. 通过后再按年付费。不要选免费个人版，那个功能不全。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page, and select "Educational" when choosing a Desktop plan to apply.
2. Submit proof of enrollment or employment, such as a student ID or teacher ID, and wait for approval.
3. Pay the annual fee after approval. Do not choose the free personal edition, as it has limited features.

name_en: SQLGate Free for Students for One Year
desc_zh: GitHub 学生开发者包可免费使用 SQLGate Standard 订阅的大部分功能一年，用来连接和管理多种 SQL 数据库。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack users can access most features of the SQLGate Standard subscription for free for one year to connect to and manage various SQL databases.
claim_zh:
1. 先完成 GitHub Education 学生认证。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 登录。
claim_en:
1. First, complete your student verification at GitHub Education.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and log in with your GitHub account.

name_zh: Astah UML 学生免费许可
desc_zh: 有学术邮箱的学生可免费领取 Astah UML，仅限本人在自己的电脑上使用，不能装到教室公用电脑，教师不能使用这个学生许可。许可每年 8 月底到期，到期前重新提交表单即可续领。
desc_en: Students with an academic email can get Astah UML for free. It is for personal use on your own computer only; it cannot be installed on shared classroom computers, and teachers cannot use this student license. The license expires at the end of August each year; resubmit the form before it expires to renew.
claim_zh:
用学术邮箱提交页面上的申请表，不要再上传附件。
查收 support@astah.net 的邮件（主题含 Free Student License），没有的话看垃圾箱。
每年 8 月前重新提交一次。
claim_en:
Submit the application form on the page with your academic email; do not upload attachments.
Check for an email from support@astah.net (subject contains Free Student License); if you don't see it, check your spam folder.
Resubmit once before August each year.

name_zh: Navicat 学生一年免费许可
name_en: Navicat Free One-Year License for Students
desc_zh: 在受认证的非营利高中、大学或社区学院就读，并持有有效学校邮箱的学生，可申请一年免费、不可转售的 Navicat Premium、Data Modeler、Monitor 非商业版和 Navicat Cloud Pro。培训机构和非认证学校不能申请。每人只能申请一次，只能用于学习，不能交给第三方使用或谋利。
desc_en: Students enrolled in an accredited non-profit high school, university, or community college and holding a valid school email address may apply for a free, non-transferable one-year license to Navicat Premium, Data Modeler, Monitor Non-Commercial Edition, and Navicat Cloud Pro. Training institutions and non-accredited schools are not eligible. Each person may apply only once, and the license may be used solely for educational purposes, not transferred to third parties or used for profit.
claim_zh:
1. 打开学生申请页，填写 NAPP 申请表，并使用学校邮箱。
2. 确认学校是受认证的非营利高中、大学或社区学院。
3. 审核通过后获得一年许可。同一人不能再次申请。
claim_en:
1. Open the student application page, fill out the NAPP application form, and use your school email address.
2. Confirm that your school is an accredited non-profit high school, university, or community college.
3. Upon approval, you will receive a one-year license. The same individual cannot apply again.

name_en: Zed Pro for Students – One Year
desc_zh: Zed 是带 AI 的协作代码编辑器。大学生验证通过后，可免费使用 Zed Pro 一年，包含每月 $10 AI 额度，以及无限次编辑预测。
desc_en: Zed is a collaborative code editor with AI. After verification, university students can use Zed Pro for free for one year, including a monthly $10 AI credit and unlimited editing suggestions.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用大学邮箱登录 Zed。
2. 完成学生认证。通过后看账户里是否出现一年 Pro 和每月 $10 额度。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and log in to Zed with your university email.
2. Complete student verification. Once approved, check your account to see if the one-year Pro subscription and monthly $10 credit have been added.

name_zh: Replit 学生版 Core 会员
desc_zh: Replit 是浏览器端 AI 编程与部署平台，支持随时随地编写、运行和部署代码。使用.edu 教育邮箱认证后，可享受 Core 会员 5 折优惠，仅需 $10/月（原价 $20/月）。适合正在构建作品集、个人项目和创业项目的学生。会员权益包括：完整 AI 额度的 Replit Agent（AI 自动编程助手）、无限私有应用（Private Apps）、生产级应用部署（Deploy）、更快的工作空间（Workspace）性能。
desc_en: Replit is a browser-based AI coding and deployment platform for writing, running, and deploying code from anywhere. Verified students with a.edu email get 50% off the Core membership — just $10/month (regular $20/month). Ideal for students building portfolios, side projects, and startups. Benefits include: Replit Agent with full AI credits, unlimited private apps, production app deployment, and faster workspaces.
claim_zh: 1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」。2. 使用学校颁发的.edu 邮箱注册或登录 Replit 账号。3. 按页面提示完成学生身份验证。4. 验证通过后，Core 会员将以 $10/月（5折）价格提供，包含完整 AI Agent 额度、无限私有应用、生产部署与更快工作空间。
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. Register or sign in to Replit with your school-issued.edu email.
3. Follow the on-page instructions to complete student verification.
4. After verification, Core membership is available at $10/month (50% off), including full AI Agent quota, unlimited Private Apps, production deployment, and faster Workspace.

name_zh: Zyte Scrapy Cloud 学生单元
desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可永久免费使用 1 个 Scrapy Cloud 单元：不限成员、项目和抓取时长，数据保留 120 天。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members get 1 Scrapy Cloud unit free for as long as they qualify: unlimited team members, projects, and crawl time, with 120-day data retention.
claim_zh:
1. 先通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生验证。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，按 Pack 入口领取。
3. 权益为 1 个永久免费单元。问题可写 support@zyte.com。
claim_en:
1. First verify your student status through GitHub Student Developer Pack.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and claim it through the Pack entry.
3. The benefit is 1 permanently free unit. For questions, email support@zyte.com.

desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可领 Blockchair API 密钥：10 万次请求，有效期 1 年，覆盖多条区块链数据。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members can get a Blockchair API key with 100,000 requests, valid for 1 year, across multiple blockchains.
claim_zh:
1. 先加入 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 登录领取密钥。
3. 额度为 10 万次请求、1 年。用完或到期后按普通方案计。
claim_en:
1. Join the GitHub Student Developer Pack first.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and sign in with GitHub to claim your key.
3. The allowance is 100,000 requests for 1 year. After it runs out or expires, regular plan charges apply.

desc_zh: 用学校邮箱注册 Mapbox 即可按用量使用免费额度。官方写免费额度足够覆盖几乎所有学生项目，没有单独的无限教育许可。
desc_en: Create a Mapbox account with a school email and use the usage-based free tier. Mapbox says that tier covers almost all student projects. There is no separate unlimited education license.
claim_zh:
1. 用学校邮箱在本页的「前往官网领取」注册。
2. 按免费额度做课程和作业，超出后按量计费。
3. 课程合作可按页面联系 Mapbox。
claim_en:
1. Register with a school email at the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. Use the free tier for courses and assignments; anything beyond that is billed by usage.
3. For course collaborations, contact Mapbox via the page.

desc_zh: Cursor 从 2026 年 6 月 25 日起停止新的学生优惠注册。以前领到的人可以维持到期；没领过的不能再拿一年免费 Pro，也没有五折。本科生要等校园或线上活动的额度，硕士、博士、研究者和教师只能填表申请额度。
desc_en: Cursor will stop accepting new student discount registrations starting June 25, 2026. Those who previously received the discount can continue using it until its expiration. Those who have not yet received it can no longer get a year of free Pro access or a 50% discount. Undergraduate students should wait for quotas available through campus or online events, while master's and doctoral students, researchers, and teachers can only apply for quotas by filling out a form.
claim_zh: 新的学生优惠已经结束。已经领过的，到期前到账单页取消，否则会按原方案续费。不要再按旧教程做学生认证。
claim_en: The new student discount has ended. If you have already received it, cancel it on the billing page before it expires; otherwise, it will be renewed under the original plan. Do not follow the old tutorial to complete student verification anymore.

desc_zh: 学生可免信用卡在 Catalyst 上部署非商业项目。每 6 个月免费用量上限 $250，到顶会暂停而不会自动扣费，可向支持申请延长。
desc_en: Students can deploy non-commercial apps on Catalyst with no card. Free usage is capped at $250 per six months. Hitting the cap pauses the app instead of charging you; Support can extend genuine student projects.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」用学生身份开始。
2. 无需订阅或信用卡，用于学习和非商业项目。
3. 6 个月内用量到 $250 会暂停。需要更多额度时联系 Catalyst Support，说明项目用途。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and start as a student.
2. No subscription or credit card required; for learning and non-commercial projects.
3. Usage reaching $250 within 6 months will pause. When you need more quota, contact Catalyst Support and explain your project purpose.

desc_zh: 中国大陆在读大学生可以申请网易 VIP 邮箱。活动页还会附送网易云音乐、严选或云笔记等会员，具体礼包以当季页面为准。
desc_en: Currently enrolled university students in mainland China can apply for a NetEase VIP email account. The event page also includes complimentary memberships to NetEase Cloud Music, Yanxuan, or Cloud Notes. The specific gift package is subject to the current season's page.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，准备好学信网或学校邮箱等在读证明。
2. 按页面完成学生认证后再领取邮箱和附赠会员。礼包内容会变，以提交时页面列出的为准。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and prepare proof of enrollment, such as your Xuexin.com profile or school email address.
2. Complete the student verification on the page, then claim your email account and complimentary memberships. The gift package contents may vary and are subject to what is listed on the page at the time of submission.

desc_zh: think-cell 是 PowerPoint 图表插件。在读学生可以申请免费许可，用来做课程演示。
desc_en: think-cell is a PowerPoint chart add-in. Current students can apply for a free license to use in course presentations.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用学校邮箱填写学生许可申请。
2. 准备好在读证明。许可发到邮箱后，再按邮件安装。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and fill out the student license application using your school email.
2. Have proof of enrollment ready. After the license is sent to your email, follow the instructions in the email to install it.

name_en: Tongyi Tingwu University Public Welfare Program
desc_zh: 阿里云通义听悟的高校公益计划把存储扩到 200 GB，并送 500 小时转写。只给符合页面要求的高校用户，用完不会自动再送。
desc_en: Alibaba Cloud's Tongyi Tingwu university public welfare plan expands storage to 200 GB and includes 500 hours of transcription. This offer is exclusively for university users who meet the requirements on the page; no additional hours will be automatically provided after usage.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，用阿里云或学校要求的账号登录。
2. 完成高校认证后再看存储和转写时长。500 小时是总额，不是每月 500 小时。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and log in with your Alibaba Cloud account or the account required by your university.
2. Complete university verification to view your storage and transcription time. The 500 hours is a total allowance, not 500 hours per month.

desc_zh: 有大学或教育机构邮箱可自动获 Screen Studio 四折优惠。没有机构邮箱可把学生证发到 team@screen.studio 领取折扣码。
desc_en: A university or institutional email unlocks 40% off Screen Studio automatically. No school email? Send a student ID to team@screen.studio for a discount code.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，填写学校/机构邮箱（如.edu、.ac.jp）。
2. 验证通过后自动获得 40% 教育折扣。
3. 没有机构邮箱：把学生证等证明发到 team@screen.studio，对方会发折扣码。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and enter your school/institution email (such as.edu,.ac.jp).
2. After verification, you automatically get a 40% education discount.
3. No institutional email: send your student ID or other proof to team@screen.studio, and they will send you a discount code.

desc_zh: 用学生邮箱申请后，MindMap AI 学生价可超过 7 折：Basic 由 $9.99 降至 $2.99/月，Pro 由 $14.99 降至 $4.49/月。折扣码约 48 小时内邮件发送。
desc_en: Students can get over 70% off MindMap AI: Basic drops from $9.99 to $2.99/month, Pro from $14.99 to $4.49/month. The code is emailed within about 48 hours of verification.
claim_zh:
1. 用学生邮箱在本页的「前往官网领取」注册。
2. 提交在读证明。没有.edu 时，官方接受其他认证院校邮箱。
3. 约 48 小时内查收折扣码并激活。在读期间可按月续，折扣不能转给他人。
claim_en:
1. Register at the "Get it on the official site" button on this page with a student email.
2. Submit proof of enrollment. If you do not have a.edu address, other verified school emails are officially accepted.
3. Check for the discount code within about 48 hours and activate it. You can renew monthly while enrolled; the discount cannot be transferred to others.

name_zh: 网易有道词典学生认证（已结束）
desc_zh: 有道词典曾经对学生认证后开放文档翻译。该认证活动已结束，页面不再发放学生权益。
desc_en: Youdao Dictionary previously offered document translation to students after certification. This certification event has ended, and the page no longer provides student benefits.
claim_zh: 这个学生认证活动已经结束。文档翻译是否还收费，以有道词典当前会员说明为准。
claim_en: This student certification event has already ended. Whether document translation is still subject to a fee depends on the current membership terms of Youdao Dictionary.

desc_zh: Paperguide 用来检索、整理和写文献。免费档含每月 2,000 AI 点数；面向学生和独立研究者的 Plus 为年付约 $12/席/月。页面没有单独的学生免费许可。
desc_en: Paperguide searches, organizes, and drafts research. The free plan includes 2,000 AI credits a month. Plus, aimed at students and independent researchers, is about $12 per seat per month billed annually. There is no separate free student license on the pricing page.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 可先用免费档。学生向方案是 Plus（年付展示价约 $12/席/月），不是学校邮箱自动免单。
3. 价格以结算页为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. You can start with the free tier. The student-oriented plan is Plus (displayed annual price about $12/seat/month), it is not automatically free with a school email.
3. Prices are subject to the checkout page.
